events.vendor: Guided Brewery Tour and Sake Tasting

events.title: Warm Sake Tasting Class and Brewery Tour
events.description:
Exploring sake temperature and pairing — warm sake, done right, is a revelation.
For a long time, warm sake has gotten a bad rap! But it can be absolutely delicious when you pick the right sake and the right temperature. Join us for this exciting exploration of sake temperature and the joys of warming sake — the perfect way to explore the subtle umami and richness of premium sake.
We’ll contrast chilled sake with the same sake served warm, and enjoy carefully selected food pairings to round out the tasting flight. In all, we’ll taste five kinds of sake, each paired with a delicious bite to bring out the flavors and textures. As always, this class includes a behind-the-scenes brewery tour to see how sake is made at NY State’s first sake brewery.

events.title: Arsenal Worldwide Fan Zone
events.description:
Arsenal Worldwide is coming to New York.


On Saturday 7th November, we’re taking over Industry City, Brooklyn for our first-ever Arsenal Worldwide supporter event in the USA.


Join us and your fellow Gooners for a free, action-packed day celebrating The Arsenal:



Watch Arsenal v Hull City live
Meet Arsenal legend Santi Cazorla
See the Premier League trophy
Look out for Gunnersaurus
Take on football challenges and competitions
Explore activations from Arsenal partners
Win exclusive Arsenal prizes, from club merchandise to an all-expenses paid trip to Saint Lucia
Enjoy food, drink and much more throughout the day



AM: Warehouse Watch Party | 09:00-12:00 (SOLD OUT)


Join us in the morning as we welcome local Gooners for a live watch party as Arsenal take on Hull City (K.O. 10am ET).


Grab your free Warehouse Party ticket while they last and join the red and white army as we bring N5 to NYC!

PM: Arsenal Worldwide | Fan Zone | 12:00-17:00

events.title: Industry City Gourmet Food and Drinks Tour
events.description:
Set against the iconic backdrop of Sunset Park’s historic waterfront, the massive, revitalized structures of Industry City form a breathtaking stage for an exclusive culinary journey. This premium food and cocktail tour is a curated exploration of taste and craft, transforming an evening into a memorable, high-end experience.
Your adventure begins with artistic bonbons at Lilac Chocolates, explores gourmet imports at Sahadi’s, and includes a refined whiskey tasting at Fort Hamilton Distillery, followed by a sophisticated sake flight. Savor additional artisanal discoveries within the awe-inspiring industrial halls.
Perfect as a distinctive date night, this tour is also fully customizable for private groups and corporate retreats. We specialize in tailoring this engaging experience for team-building and client entertainment, making it an ideal one-day corporate outing. A sophisticated mini-vacation for locals and a profound discovery for visitors.
